name: JoAi: List Rooms

description.en: List the chat rooms of a team, including their agent and integration type. Use it to find the room hashid for reading messages or to get an overview of recent conversations. Results can be searched, sorted by last activity and limited.
description.de: Liste die Chat-Räume eines Teams inklusive Agent und Integrationstyp auf. Nutze es, um die Raum-Hashid zum Lesen von Nachrichten zu finden oder dir einen Überblick über aktuelle Unterhaltungen zu verschaffen. Ergebnisse lassen sich durchsuchen, nach letzter Aktivität sortieren und begrenzen.
description.es: List the chat rooms of a team, including their agent and integration type. Use it to find the room hashid for reading messages or to get an overview of recent conversations. Results can be searched, sorted by last activity and limited.
description.fr: List the chat rooms of a team, including their agent and integration type. Use it to find the room hashid for reading messages or to get an overview of recent conversations. Results can be searched, sorted by last activity and limited.
description.it: List the chat rooms of a team, including their agent and integration type. Use it to find the room hashid for reading messages or to get an overview of recent conversations. Results can be searched, sorted by last activity and limited.
description.ro: List the chat rooms of a team, including their agent and integration type. Use it to find the room hashid for reading messages or to get an overview of recent conversations. Results can be searched, sorted by last activity and limited.

bot: Use this when the user wants to see, list, or check the rooms or channels of a team. Defaults to the current team; pass a team slug to list another team. Use search to find a room by name and limit to keep the result small.

inputs.name: Team

description.en: Team slug for this action. Defaults to the current team.
description.de: Team-Slug für diese Aktion. Standardmäßig das aktuelle Team.
description.es: Team slug for this action. Defaults to the current team.
description.fr: Team slug for this action. Defaults to the current team.
description.it: Team slug for this action. Defaults to the current team.
description.ro: Team slug for this action. Defaults to the current team.

inputs.bot: The slug of the team to list rooms for. Omit to use the current team.

inputs.name: Search
inputs.bot: Filter rooms by a name fragment, e.g. a contact or channel name.

inputs.name: Sort

description.en: Sort rooms by lastActivity or created (default lastActivity)
description.de: Räume nach lastActivity oder created sortieren (Standard lastActivity)
description.es: Ordena las salas por lastActivity o created (lastActivity por defecto)
description.fr: Trier les salons par lastActivity ou created (lastActivity par défaut)
description.it: Ordina le stanze per lastActivity o created (lastActivity predefinito)
description.ro: Sortează camerele după lastActivity sau created (implicit lastActivity)

inputs.bot: Use lastActivity with direction desc to find recent chats.

description.en: Sort direction: asc or desc (default desc)
description.es: Dirección de orden: asc o desc (desc por defecto)
description.fr: Sens de tri : asc ou desc (desc par défaut)
description.it: Direzione di ordinamento: asc o desc (desc predefinito)
description.ro: Direcția de sortare: asc sau desc (implicit desc)

inputs.name: Limit

description.en: Maximum number of rooms to return (default 50, max 200)
description.es: Número máximo de salas a devolver (50 por defecto, máx. 200)
description.fr: Nombre maximal de salons à renvoyer (50 par défaut, max. 200)
description.it: Numero massimo di stanze da restituire (50 predefinito, max 200)
description.ro: Numărul maxim de camere returnate (50 implicit, max 200)

inputs.bot: Keep the result small; omit for the default of 50.
